# attachment-extension-gate

acceptsAttachment(filename) accepts a POSIX path string exactly when its final extension is lowercase pdf or jpg. Compare the final extension only, without its leading dot. Matching is case sensitive: PDF is rejected. A hidden file named .pdf has no extension and is rejected. Files without an extension and other extensions are rejected.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
